<?php
/**
 * Feature Flag CLI Tool - manages feature toggles for deployment pipeline
 * Usage: php featurectl.php [command] [options]
 */

class FeatureRegistry {
    private array $flags = [];
    private ?array $resolvedDeps = null;
    private string $configPath;

    public function __construct(string $configPath) {
        $this->configPath = $configPath;
    }

    public function loadFromConfig(): void {
        if (!file_exists($this->configPath)) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Config not found: {$this->configPath}");
        }
        $data = json_decode(file_get_contents($this->configPath), true);
        if (!is_array($data)) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Invalid config format");
        }
        foreach ($data as $name => $definition) {
            $this->flags[$name] = new FeatureFlag(
                $name,
                $definition['enabled'] ?? false,
                $definition['dependencies'] ?? [],
                $definition['rollout_percentage'] ?? 100
            );
        }
    }

    public function getFlag(string $name): ?FeatureFlag {
        return $this->flags[$name] ?? null;
    }

    public function resolveDependencyChain(string $flagName): ?array {
        if ($this->resolvedDeps !== null) {
            return $this->resolvedDeps;
        }
        $flag = $this->getFlag($flagName);
        if ($flag === null) {
            return null;
        }
        $chain = [];
        $this->buildChain($flag, $chain, []);
        $this->resolvedDeps = $chain;
        return $chain;
    }

    private function buildChain(FeatureFlag $flag, array &$chain, array $visited): void {
        if (in_array($flag->getName(), $visited)) {
            return; // circular dependency protection
        }
        $visited[] = $flag->getName();
        foreach ($flag->getDependencies() as $depName) {
            $dep = $this->getFlag($depName);
            if ($dep !== null) {
                $this->buildChain($dep, $chain, $visited);
            }
            $chain[] = $depName;
        }
    }

    public function getAllFlags(): array {
        return $this->flags;
    }
}

class FeatureFlag {
    private string $name;
    private bool $enabled;
    private array $dependencies;
    private int $rolloutPercentage;

    public function __construct(string $name, bool $enabled, array $dependencies, int $rolloutPercentage) {
        $this->name = $name;
        $this->enabled = $enabled;
        $this->dependencies = $dependencies;
        $this->rolloutPercentage = $rolloutPercentage;
    }

    public function getName(): string { return $this->name; }
    public function isEnabled(): bool { return $this->enabled; }
    public function getDependencies(): array { return $this->dependencies; }
    public function getRolloutPercentage(): int { return $this->rolloutPercentage; }
}

class EvaluationContext {
    private ?string $userId;
    private ?string $environment;
    private array $attributes;

    public function __construct(?string $userId, ?string $environment, array $attributes = []) {
        $this->userId = $userId;
        $this->environment = $environment;
        $this->attributes = $attributes;
    }

    public function getUserId(): ?string { return $this->userId; }
    public function getEnvironment(): ?string { return $this->environment; }
    public function getAttribute(string $key): mixed { return $this->attributes[$key] ?? null; }
}

class FlagEvaluator {
    private FeatureRegistry $registry;

    public function __construct(FeatureRegistry $registry) {
        $this->registry = $registry;
    }

    /**
     * Evaluates whether a feature flag is active for the given context.
     * Returns null if the flag doesn't exist, true/false otherwise.
     */
    public function evaluate(string $flagName, EvaluationContext $context): ?bool {
        $flag = $this->registry->getFlag($flagName);
        if ($flag === null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (!$flag->isEnabled()) {
            return false;
        }

        // Check dependency chain satisfaction
        if (!$this->areDependenciesSatisfied($flagName, $context)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Rollout percentage check
        return $this->isInRolloutCohort($flag, $context);
    }

    private function areDependenciesSatisfied(string $flagName, EvaluationContext $context): bool {
        $chain = $this->registry->resolveDependencyChain($flagName);
        if ($chain === null) {
            return true; // no dependencies
        }
        foreach ($chain as $depName) {
            $depFlag = $this->registry->getFlag($depName);
            // If dependency flag exists and is disabled, deps not satisfied
            if ($depFlag !== null && !$depFlag->isEnabled()) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private function isInRolloutCohort(FeatureFlag $flag, EvaluationContext $context): bool {
        if ($flag->getRolloutPercentage() >= 100) {
            return true;
        }
        if ($flag->getRolloutPercentage() <= 0) {
            return false;
        }
        $userId = $context->getUserId();
        if ($userId === null) {
            return false;
        }
        $hash = crc32($flag->getName() . ':' . $userId);
        $bucket = abs($hash) % 100;
        return $bucket < $flag->getRolloutPercentage();
    }
}

class FeatureCLI {
    private FeatureRegistry $registry;
    private FlagEvaluator $evaluator;
    private ?EvaluationContext $context;

    public function __construct(string $configPath) {
        $this->registry = new FeatureRegistry($configPath);
        $this->registry->loadFromConfig();
        $this->evaluator = new FlagEvaluator($this->registry);
        $this->context = null;
    }

    public function run(array $argv): int {
        $command = $argv[1] ?? 'help';

        switch ($command) {
            case 'list':
                return $this->listFlags();
            case 'check':
                return $this->checkFlag($argv);
            case 'deps':
                return $this->showDeps($argv);
            case 'evaluate':
                return $this->evaluateFlag($argv);
            default:
                return $this->showHelp();
        }
    }

    private function listFlags(): int {
        $flags = $this->registry->getAllFlags();
        foreach ($flags as $flag) {
            $status = $flag->isEnabled() ? '\033[32mON\033[0m' : '\033[31mOFF\033[0m';
            printf("  %-30s [%s] (%d%%)\n", $flag->getName(), $status, $flag->getRolloutPercentage());
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private function checkFlag(array $argv): int {
        $flagName = $argv[2] ?? null;
        if ($flagName === null) {
            fwrite(STDERR, "Usage: featurectl check <flag_name>\n");
            return 1;
        }
        $flag = $this->registry->getFlag($flagName);
        if ($flag === null) {
            fwrite(STDERR, "Flag not found: {$flagName}\n");
            return 1;
        }
        echo $flag->isEnabled() ? "enabled\n" : "disabled\n";
        return 0;
    }

    private function showDeps(array $argv): int {
        $flagName = $argv[2] ?? null;
        if ($flagName === null) {
            fwrite(STDERR, "Usage: featurectl deps <flag_name>\n");
            return 1;
        }
        $chain = $this->registry->resolveDependencyChain($flagName);
        if ($chain === null) {
            fwrite(STDERR, "Flag not found: {$flagName}\n");
            return 1;
        }
        if (empty($chain)) {
            echo "No dependencies\n";
        } else {
            foreach ($chain as $dep) {
                echo "  -> {$dep}\n";
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private function evaluateFlag(array $argv): int {
        $flagName = $argv[2] ?? null;
        if ($flagName === null) {
            fwrite(STDERR, "Usage: featurectl evaluate <flag_name> [--user=ID] [--env=ENV]\n");
            return 1;
        }

        $userId = null;
        $env = null;
        for ($i = 3; $i < count($argv); $i++) {
            if (str_starts_with($argv[$i], '--user=')) {
                $userId = substr($argv[$i], 7);
            } elseif (str_starts_with($argv[$i], '--env=')) {
                $env = substr($argv[$i], 6);
            }
        }

        $this->context = $this->buildContext($userId, $env);
        $result = $this->evaluator->evaluate($flagName, $this->context);

        if ($result === null) {
            fwrite(STDERR, "Flag not found: {$flagName}\n");
            return 1;
        }

        echo $result ? "ACTIVE\n" : "INACTIVE\n";
        $this->printContextSummary();
        return 0;
    }

    private function buildContext(?string $userId, ?string $env): EvaluationContext {
        // Always return a valid context - use defaults for missing values
        return new EvaluationContext(
            $userId,
            $env ?? 'production'
        );
    }

    private function printContextSummary(): void {
        // Display context info for debugging
        $envLabel = $this->context->getEnvironment() ?? 'default';
        $userLabel = $this->context->getUserId() ?? 'anonymous';
        echo "  Context: user={$userLabel}, env={$envLabel}\n";
    }

    private function showHelp(): int {
        echo "Feature Flag CLI Tool\n";
        echo "Commands:\n";
        echo "  list                    List all feature flags\n";
        echo "  check <name>            Check if a flag is enabled\n";
        echo "  deps <name>             Show dependency chain\n";
        echo "  evaluate <name> [opts]  Evaluate flag for context\n";
        return 0;
    }
}

// Entry point
$configFile = getenv('FEATURE_CONFIG') ?: __DIR__ . '/features.json';
try {
    $cli = new FeatureCLI($configFile);
    exit($cli->run($argv));
} catch (RuntimeException $e) {
    fwrite(STDERR, "Error: " . $e->getMessage() . "\n");
    exit(2);
}
